form.statement: The toothbrush Form is honest when it treats worn bristles as a rational consumable renewal cycle instead of pretending the handle is permanent.
form.scope: Imported from the 100-record register as a nonterminal CONSUMABLE research case. The ordinary use context, jurisdiction, and exact Form boundary remain part of adjudication.
exclusions: Hard bristles that damage enamel, inaccessible or unnecessary electronics, replacement cycles hidden by marketing, and a handle claim that ignores bristle wear.

subject.productionLineage: Exact model identity and production continuity remain to be verified.

evidenceGaps: Attach at least one primary technical or service source.
Attach independent evidence of longevity, failure behavior, or repair economics.
Record the strongest counter-case and the exact model or child Form boundary.

categorySearch.protocol: Research disposition imported from the canonical register. The case must record the candidate set, search coverage, and why the chosen Form is coherent before terminal review.

failureModes.remedy: Bristle splay, contamination, handle damage, and replacement timing missed through overuse.

maintenance: Replace on the clinically appropriate schedule; keep the handle and packaging simple where possible.
repairEconomics: Not yet established. Compare parts, labor, access, downtime, and rational replacement cost before terminal review.
